module: Unfinished draft of a vehicle rental system in career: most functions contain only comments, and the hooks (onExtensionLoaded, onSaveCurrentProfile, onUpdate) are commented out. Only isRenting is exported.
notes: Inactive code: currRentalVeh is never assigned (beginRenting declares a local variable of the same name and uses an undefined shopId), so isRenting always returns false.
playAbandonTimer and trackAbandonVeh use currAbandonTime while the declared variable is named currAbandonTimer: bug if the code were enabled.

isRenting.desc: UI API: indicates whether a rental vehicle is in progress (currRentalVeh not nil).
